text:
ana (Product Designer): quick design review — Create API key modal: when orgs have many roles the picker overflows and the chips become a scrolling list. users lose context and some think roles attach to their user instead of the key.

tom (PM): saw a support case about that. can we add a short clarifier next to the picker: 'These roles apply only to this API key.' simple change but reduces confusion. :white_check_mark:

lee (Frontend): i can repro a keyboard trap. tabbing into the chip list and using arrows can get focus stuck. plus the chip remove control isn't exposed to keyboards well.

harper (Accessibility): confirmed on NVDA — chips read as plain text. recommend:
- add an aria-live polite region that announces "n roles selected" on changes
- label remove buttons "Remove role <name>"
- ensure the "Show secret" toggle has an accessible name and aria-pressed

ana (Product Designer): idea: show up to 5 chips inline then a "+N more" button that opens a compact modal with the full list + checkboxes. also display a small inline note: "These roles apply to this key." Keeps the primary flow tidy.

tom (PM): for wildcard/admin scopes we need a stronger inline banner (icon + orange tint). current wording is too subtle. suggested short copy: "Warning: Grants wide access (e.g. admin.*). Use only for trusted services." with a small disclosure "why this matters" that reveals one line.

lee (Frontend): implementation notes: condensed chips are CSS; the "+N more" must be a real button opening a role=dialog with focus trap. i'll patch the arrow handlers so list container owns keyboard navigation and tabbing out works. will include data-telemetry attributes: create_modal_open, create_submit, overflow_open, banner_ack.

harper (Accessibility): prefer custom disclosure to manage aria-expanded and announce changes. ensure dialog receives focus and announces a title. check banner contrast — orange background #FFF5E6 vs text looks borderline at small sizes; increase weight or darken text.

ana (Product Designer): proposed microcopy for banner (short):

"Warning: This key grants wide access (admin.*). Use only for trusted services. Limit scopes and rotate regularly."

tom (PM): looks good. instead of sending people to docs, show the one-line "why this matters" inline so users stay in flow.

lee (Frontend): will add aria-live and labelled remove buttons. also expose data-testid on the "+N more" and banner for QA. planning branch fix/keypicker-clarity.

ci-bot: build passed for branch "fix/keypicker-clarity" — running accessibility test suite (8 tests failing). report: https://ci.internal/reports/789

harper (Accessibility): i'll triage the failing tests — likely focus order and missing aria attributes.

ana (Product Designer): action items:
1) lee: implement condensed chips + overflow dialog + keyboard fixes + telemetry (PR by Tue)
2) harper: draft accessible copy & a11y checklist (review by Wed)
3) tom: add telemetry spec + wording for inline disclosure
4) ana: update empty-state copy: "You don't have any API keys yet — create one to get started" and mock the condensed chips for the design review

tom (PM): also flag: rotation flow follow-up — when rotating keys keep role assignments visible and show a short timeline in the rotate confirmation.

ana (Product Designer): great. i'll upload mocks and microcopy options later today. thanks! :thumbsup:
